S-1: You stand at a cairn on the open heath, the next one already in sight. Raidho is a road marked out one stone at a time, each seen from the last. No cairn shows the whole heath, Thor, only the way to the next. Behind you, the one you passed still stands where you left it.
S-2: You stand beside a cairn on the open heath, and the next one rises in plain sight. Raidho is the road these markers make, each one found from the one before. From here, Thor, the far edge of the heath cannot be seen. The next cairn stands where it has always stood, near enough to see.
S-3: You stand beside a cairn on the open heath, and the next one shows on the rise ahead. Behind you the last one is still in sight. Raidho is the way kept open, Thor, from one stone you can see to the next. Someone set each one where the last could still be seen.
W-1: You stand beside a cairn on the open heath, and the next one shows small on the far rise. Behind you, Thor, the one you left still stands in sight. Raidho is the road made walkable, each marker leading to the one ahead. From any stone on this heath, the next is already in view.
W-2: You stand at a cairn on the heath, and the next one shows small on the rise ahead. Raidho carries the road from marker to marker, each set in sight of the last. From here, Thor, you see as far as the next stone and no farther. Behind you, the last one still stands where someone set it.
W-3: You stand by a cairn on the open heath, and the next one stands in view. Raidho is a road you can follow, each stone in sight of the one before. Thor, the end of the heath lies beyond sight, and the next stone does not. Behind you, the cairn you came from still holds its place.
